shortTitle: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Prescribing Trends in JAMA Network Open
longTitle: Prescribing Trends of Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists for Type 2 Diabetes or Obesity
summary: An excellent analysis of prescribing trends for GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes or obesity using electronic health records data, led by Piaopiao Li.
citation: Li P, Varghese JS, et al. Prescribing Trends of Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists for Type 2 Diabetes or Obesity. JAMA Netw Open. 2025;8(9):e2540890. doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2025.40890
